faq.a: Yes. It is completely free with no account required and no hidden limits. The AI runs on a free tier that is plenty for regular personal use.

faq.q: Does it work with any YouTube video?
faq.a: It works with any video that has captions enabled. Manually added subtitles give the most accurate results; otherwise the tool uses YouTube's auto-generated captions.

faq.q: Do I need to watch the video first?
faq.a: No. Just paste the link. The tool reads the transcript and gives you a summary, key points and chapters so you can jump straight to the parts you care about.

faq.q: Is the summary accurate?
faq.a: It is based directly on the video's transcript, so it reflects what was actually said. For auto-generated captions, minor wording errors can occur because speech-to-text is not perfect.

faq.q: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: The video link and its transcript are processed by a serverless function to generate the summary. No account is created and nothing is stored long-term.
